method: Across the 22 formal/curated programs (excluding raw Q&A/OEIS-unformalized streams), exact normalized base-title matching (NFKD, lowercase, parenthetical/possessive/stop-word removal) combined with reviewed curated overrides in data/external/lefttosolve/crosswalk_overrides.json
policy: Advisory only. A Left to Solve 'solved' flag never modifies the status of any curated Mega-Atlas problem; matching solved flags are listed under external_solved_signals for human review (links are title/identity-level, not statement-fidelity certifications).
